settings.delete.body: The stopwatch, its goal and its shortcut are removed. Statistics already logged for it are kept.
settings.newCycle.title: Start a new goal cycle for {name}?
settings.newCycle.body: The current cycle ends unfinished and is shown as cancelled in Statistics. Time from now on counts toward the new cycle.

settings.stopwatch.permanentInfo: Kept every day. Temporary stopwatches disappear after a full day without use.
settings.language.title: Language

goalNotify.title: Notify when a goal is reached

update.confirmBody: Version {version} will be downloaded and installed, then the app restarts. Running stopwatches keep running.
update.installedRestart: Update installed. Restart the app to use it
dbError.title: Can’t open your data
dbError.newerVersion: Your data was saved by a newer version of WowStopwatcher. Install the latest version to open it. Nothing was changed.
dbError.damaged: The data file looks damaged, so the app stopped to keep it safe. Nothing was changed. Keep a copy of the file before trying to fix it.
dbError.unavailable: The data file could not be opened. It may be in use or not accessible. Nothing was changed.
dbError.backupFailed: A backup of your data could not be made before updating it, so the app stopped. Nothing was changed. Check that there is free disk space and the data folder is writable.
dbError.folderMissing: The data folder isn’t available. Its drive may not be connected or the sync may not be finished. Nothing was changed and no new data was created.
dbError.locationDamaged: The file that stores where your data folder is looks damaged. Nothing was changed. You can go back to the default location; your data in the other folder is not deleted.
transfer.error.copyFailed: The data couldn’t be copied or didn’t pass the check.
transfer.error.backupFailed: A backup couldn’t be made first.
transfer.error.notAZip: This is not a backup file (not a zip archive).
transfer.error.noDatabase: This is not a WowStopwatcher backup (no data inside).
transfer.error.damaged: The data in the file is damaged.
transfer.error.newerVersion: The data was saved by a newer version of WowStopwatcher.
transfer.error.io: A file error occurred. Check the access rights and the free disk space.
data.title: Data
data.folder.title: Database folder
data.folder.description: Stopwatches, statistics, invoices, templates and backups live here.
data.folder.sameFolder: This is already the database folder.
data.move.title: Move the data here?
data.move.body: The data is copied to {folder}. The app restarts and running stopwatches keep running. The old file stays where it is.
data.existing.title: {folder} already has a database
data.existing.hint: Use it, or replace it with the data on this computer (it is backed up first).
data.existing.restartNote: The app restarts. With “Replace it with mine” running stopwatches keep running; with “Use that database” they are stopped and saved first. The old file stays where it was.
data.existing.newer: This database was saved by a newer version of WowStopwatcher. Install the latest version to use it.
data.existing.damaged: This database looks damaged and can’t be used.
data.sync.warning: A synced folder (OneDrive, Dropbox) works, but never run the app on two devices at the same time with the same database.
data.backup.title: Backup file
data.backup.description: Export saves everything in one file, the safe way to move to another device. Import replaces the current data after backing it up.
data.import.confirmBody: Replaces all current data. A backup of the current data is made first. Running stopwatches are stopped and saved, then the app restarts.
data.outcome.moved: The data now lives in the new folder. The old file was left where it was.
data.outcome.replaced: The database in the new folder was replaced with yours. A backup of the previous one was made first.
data.outcome.imported: The backup was imported. A backup of the previous data was made first.
data.outcome.failedBody: {reason} Nothing was changed; your data is still used as before.

invoicing.noCompanies: No companies yet. Add one to start billing the time of your stopwatches.
invoicing.company.deleteBody: The company is removed from this page and its stopwatches are released. Its past invoices are kept.

invoicing.settings.stopwatchesHint: · a stopwatch can belong to one company

invoicing.placeholders.description: Write {{{{alias}}}} in the template. A script returns the value; it can read hours, rate, amount, period, lines and ph, and format(date) uses the company date format.
invoicing.placeholders.automaticHint: Built-in value. Choose Static or Script to override it.
invoicing.placeholders.hideNote: Built-in rate, amount and line.amount are always hidden with amounts. Mark a placeholder with the eye to hide its result too.
invoicing.placeholders.notSaved: Fix the aliases to save the changes.
invoicing.placeholders.unknown: The template uses {{{{{name}}}}}, which has no value

invoicing.preview.hiddenBody: The invoice shows the rate and amounts. Show amounts to see the preview.

invoicing.details.sentBanner: Sent on {date}. Lines, rate and placeholder values are frozen.
invoicing.details.mergeNeighbours: Merge works within one day or neighbouring days
invoicing.details.mergeDays.title: Merge into one day

invoicing.details.mergeSelect: Select two or more lines of one day or neighbouring days to merge

invoicing.details.reset.title: Reset this day?
invoicing.details.reset.body: The edited lines of {day} are replaced by the tracked time. Notes on them are lost.
invoicing.details.footer: Only lines with a note are billed; lines without a note are unallocated time. Days you have not edited follow the tracked time. Time is rounded to minutes. Reported hours for the month, when set, replace the total of the noted lines; the lines still fill the table.
invoicing.details.error.sent: The invoice is sent, so nothing was changed.
invoicing.details.reported.label: Reported for the month
invoicing.details.reported.hint: Reported time replaces the noted lines in the invoice total. Notes still fill the lines below. Format h:mm, for example 160:00.
invoicing.details.reported.invalid: Enter hours as h:mm, for example 160:00 (at least 0:01).
invoicing.income.title: This month
invoicing.income.noRate: No exchange rate for {currencies}; not included in the total.
